claims.exact_claim: For a positive L2-selfadjoint tracial TP UCP marginal Phi of a compatible splitter, ||[Phi^m A,Phi^m C]||2 <= 2 sqrt(min(Q_(m-1)(A),Q_(m-1)(C))) for Hermitian contractions, Q_k(A)=integral_[0,1](1-lambda^2)lambda^(2k)dmu_A. Uniformly it is at most 2 sqrt(k^k/(k+1)^(k+1)), k=m-1, with d_0=1.
claims.baseline_overlap: Same compatible Stinespring/Schwarz mechanism as cycle3 sandwich_broadcast_algebra. Directly applying it to the preceding power removes the baseline replacement loss and exposes input spectral weights. None of the three frozen Sol INITIALs stated this profile refinement; it does not supply the unrestricted EB map missing in all three.
claims.repairs: INITIAL integral over (0,1] must include lambda=0 at k=0, using lambda^0=1. The full proof correctly uses [0,1]. For m>=2 the omitted atom contributes zero. This is a notation repair, not a failure of the full result.
claims.independent_check: Reconstructed commuting-copy Stinespring identities Ry*Rx-Rx*Ry and both product bounds. Tracial output allows adjoint invariance of L2 and hence the minimum of the two defects. Tau(Phi x^2-(Phi x)^2)=||x||2^2-||Phi x||2^2. Spectral maximization of (1-lambda^2)lambda^(2k) gives k^k/(k+1)^(k+1). No finite test was used as proof.

claims.exact_claim: Pauli-string locking states 2^(-q)(I+(-1)^x Gamma_y), y in {X,Y,Z}^q, have mean trace distance 1/2 from their barycenter but accessible information at most (2/3)^(q/2) bits. This refutes a universal posterior information gain >= c(mean trace distance)^2/ln(number of labels).
claims.baseline_overlap: Not present in any frozen c05 Sol INITIAL. This transfers an established locking theorem into a precise falsifier of a proposed proof upgrade; it does not counterexample the broadcast-to-EB target.
claims.repairs: Information source uses bits; convert by ln2 for natural units. Keep the single-leaf/local-inequality scope. Anti-commuting pairs have affinity gap 1/sqrt2-1/2, so the ensemble is not evidence of vanishing broadcast error.
claims.independent_check: Read primary source full Lemma2 proof. Independently: conditional on outcome h, normalized POVM effect omega_h gives posterior p(x,y|h)=(1+(-1)^x Tr(omega_h Gamma_y))/(2*3^q). Then 1-h2((1+v)/2)<=|v| and Cauchy-Schwarz with Pauli purity gives gain <=sqrt((2^q-1)/3^q). Barycenter distance is exactly 1/2. This proves the obstruction without finite-matrix testing.
